Name: Slightly Cuter Aymeric
Author: Poltergeister
Description:
Modding to satisfy my niche interests.

You need to download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23851?tab=files]Aymeric de Borel mod[/url] by Adaire99 for it to work.

[b]Configs: [/b]

"NoNose": {"true, false"},
Defines if Aymeric has nose or not. No nose is the default. Set it to "false" if you want the nose.
        
"FestivalOutfits": {"true, false"},
Decides if Aymeric will wear festival outfits. Wearing them is the default. Set it to "false" if you don't want
the outfits.

I hope you enjoy this mod!

Manifest.Name: Slightly Cuter Aymeric
Manifest.Description: Makes Aymeric slightly cuter and gives him seasonal outfits.
Manifest.Author: Poltergeister
